subtle.$description: System fail & error alert/toast surface background.
1px border stroke for system fail card, inline alert, and danger toast.

action.$description: Active error border stroke for invalid input fields.

width.$description: Border stroke width for input fields in error state.

bold.$description: High-contrast error message title and helper text passing WCAG 2.1 AAA.

muted.$description: Calming, non-accusatory secondary description text for system failures.

base.$description: Accent color for danger/error icons (AlertOctagon, AlertCircle, RefreshCcw).

muted.$description: Muted icon color for full-view offline/server-crash illustrations.

destructive.$description: Base color for fatal/destructive recovery triggers.

surface.$description: Warm amber surface for sync conflict banners to prevent cognitive panic.

border.$description: Border stroke for sync conflict banner dialogs.

accent.$description: Accent marker and icon color for timeline sync conflicts.

text.$description: High-contrast title text for sync conflict resolutions.

offset.$description: Horizontal micro-shake offset distance on action failure.

duration.$description: Micro-shake animation duration for button action fail.
Auto-dismiss duration for danger/error toasts (6-8s) to allow reading.

min-height.$description: Reserved container min-height for input helper/error text to prevent layout shift.
